content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DHSGSU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download DHSGSU Junior Research Fellow Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow: M.Sc./ M.Tech in Microbiology/ Botany/ Biotechnology/ Life sciences with >= 55% or equivalent CGPA, CSIR-UGC NET/GATE/ equivalent examination. Candidates with experience in the relevant research work and prior knowledge and hands on experience with microbial culturing, enzymes and basic bioinformatics tools / databases will be given preference.

content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow: Maximum age is 30 years. 5 years relaxation in case of SC/ST/OBC/PH and female candidates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DHSGSU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya Sagar (DHSGSU), Madhya Pradesh, for a project-based research position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this notification?
faq.answer: The available post is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under a DBT-funded project managed by the university in Sagar.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced for this role?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. or M.Tech in Microbiology, Botany, Biotechnology, or Life sciences with at least 55% marks or equivalent CGPA, along with a qualified CSIR-UGC NET, GATE, or equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years. Age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for SC, ST, OBC, PH, and female candidates as per guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary provided for the Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of ₹37,000/- per month along with 9% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 14-10-2026. Make sure to send all required documents before this deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for DHSGSU JRF Recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through email. Candidates need to send a single PDF comprising their detailed CV and all enclosures to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their CV and qualifications, followed by an interview which can be conducted online or offline.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and application details through the important links section provided in this article.
